diff --git a/src/retry.py b/src/retry.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..6f539fd850034c0579fdc03d0c08b2ff72dd789c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/retry.py
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+"""Idempotent retry for record writes."""
+
+MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
+
+
+def persist(store, record):
+    """Write the record; a present key means an earlier attempt finished."""
+    for _ in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
+        if store.get(record["id"]):
+            return "done"
+        try:
+            store.begin()
+            store.put(record["id"], record["payload"])
+            store.commit()
+            return "done"
+        except store.Error:
+            store.rollback()
+    return "retry"
diff --git a/tests/test_retry.py b/tests/test_retry.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..91844db0b96963bf7d996d26b85e4c10e5f73af6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_retry.py
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+from src.retry import persist
+
+
+class FakeStore:
+    Error = RuntimeError
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rows = {}
+        self.failing = False
+        self._pending = None
+
+    def get(self, key):
+        return self.rows.get(key)
+
+    def begin(self):
+        pass
+
+    def put(self, key, payload):
+        self._pending = key
+        self.rows[key] = payload
+
+    def commit(self):
+        if self.failing:
+            raise RuntimeError("commit failed")
+        self._pending = None
+
+    def rollback(self):
+        if self._pending is not None:
+            self.rows.pop(self._pending, None)
+            self._pending = None
+
+
+def test_first_attempt_persists():
+    store = FakeStore()
+    assert persist(store, {"id": "a", "payload": {"n": 1}}) == "done"
+
+
+def test_retries_then_gives_up_when_commit_keeps_failing():
+    store = FakeStore()
+    store.failing = True
+    assert persist(store, {"id": "a", "payload": {"n": 1}}) == "retry"
